core_conclusion: Current evidence supports consciousness as a brain-dependent phenomenon with unresolved causal organization rather than a settled single location. CMCA makes the question testable by combining no-report constructs, multiscale recording, targeted perturbation, held-out theory comparison, and an independent Orch-OR molecular bridge stress test.
